name: Nguyen Tieu at Chua Ong
summary: People come to Chùa Ông, at 24 Trần Phú, on the 16th of the first lunar month. The city page describes worship at the temple. The 2026 plan ran from 26 February to 4 March, and the centre said it would not sell sightseeing tickets for named halls across that festival only. Next year’s civil dates, and any waiver, are check on arrival.
when: The 16th of the first lunar month. The civil date is check on arrival.
